title: Monthly CIO Operating Review
decision_request: Decide which CIO operating issues need executive attention this month.
context: Portfolio has three amber projects and one red ERP workstream.
Operations reports recurring billing incidents and MTTR rising from 9h to 16h.
Cloud spend is 18% above forecast with no clear owner for optimization.
Security privileged access review remains incomplete.
Customer master data duplication affects reporting trust.
No formal decision was made on architecture capacity funding.
